an4.33:1.1: sīho bhikkhave, migarājā sāyanhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhamati.
an4.33:1.4: samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadati.
an4.33:1.6: ye kho pana te bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā sīhassa migarañño nadato saddaṃ suṇanti, te yebhuyyena bhayaṃ saṃvegaṃ santāsaṃ āpajjanti.
an4.33:1.7: bilaṃ bilāsayā pavisanti, dakaṃ dakāsayā pavisanti, vanaṃ vanāsayā pavisanti, ākāsaṃ pakkhino bhajanti.
an4.33:1.8: yepi te bhikkhave, rañño nāgā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu daḷhehi varattehi bandhanehi baddhā, tepi tāni bandhanāni sañchinditvā sampadāḷetvā bhītā muttakarīsaṃ cajamānā yena vā tena vā palāyanti.
an4.33:1.9: evaṃ mahiddhiyo kho, bhikkhave, sīho migarājā tiracchānagatānaṃ pāṇānaṃ, evaṃ mahesakkho evaṃ mahānubhāvo.
an4.33:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yadā tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā. so dhammaṃ deseti:
an4.33:2.2: ‘iti sakkāyo, iti sakkāyasamudayo, iti sakkāyanirodho, iti sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti.
an4.33:2.3: yepi te bhikkhave, devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā uccesu vimānesu ciraṭṭhitikā, tepi tathāgatassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā yebhuyyena bhayaṃ saṃvegaṃ santāsaṃ āpajjanti.
an4.33:2.4: aniccā vata kira bho mayaṃ samānā niccamhā’ti amaññimha.
an4.33:2.5: addhuvā vata kira bho mayaṃ samānā dhuvamhā’ti amaññimha.
an4.33:2.6: asassatā vata kira bho mayaṃ samānā sassatamhā’ti amaññimha.
an4.33:2.7: mayampi kira bho aniccā addhuvā asassatā sakkāyapariyāpannā’ti.
an4.33:2.8: evaṃ mahiddhiyo kho bhikkhave, tathāgato sadevakassa lokassa. evaṃ mahesakkho evaṃ mahānubhāvoti.
